answer: Pool rewards by behavioral similarity. Each new agent posts a bond, and its answers, timing and funding paths are compared with every other account. Identities that cluster like pearls in one lagoon are treated as a single agent and split one reward, and their bonds are slashed if they hid shared control. Spinning up clones then costs extra bonds yet earns nothing more, so faking a crowd is as pricey as saffron for zero gain.
